{{Quote|The Aii`tkian Anthropologists in Area D-502 have found a new strain of copper thanks to the O.S.S. "Junk Dealers" Guild. The scientists believe the new copper will be used effectively for starship shields and various parts.|Imperial Daily News|<ref name="SWG:IDN" />}}
The '''Aii`tkian Anthropologists''' were a group of [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] active during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Aii`tkian Anthropologists were present in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]] where they explored the system's [[Area D-502]]. There, they collected rare [[Starship/Legends|starship]] equipment that highlighted the existence of an ancient, space-faring [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="SWGJtLPOGG">[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> In addition, they also operated in the [[Asair's Ribbon]] and [[Isryn's Veil]] quadrants.<ref name="Sony">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?id=66853&resource=features|text=Star Chart: Dantooine System}}</ref> Due to the lack of protection provided by the Empire, the Aii`tkian Anthropologists had allied with merchants and junk dealers,<ref name="SWGJtLPOGG" /> such as the [[O.S.S. D-502 Junk Guild]],<ref name="SWG:AD502" /> to protect themselves against the [[Zel'iphian Slave Traders Guild]].<ref name="SWGJtLPOGG" /> In space, Aii'tkian pilots flew [[Z-95-AF4 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95-AF4 Headhunters]].<ref name="SWG:DS">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other|Dantooine system}}</ref>

Around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Aii`tkian Anthropologists and the O.S.S. Junk Guild discovered a new strain of [[Copper/Legends|copper]] in the Dantooine system's Area D-502. Aii`tkian scientists then investigated whether it was worth to be used to manufacture starship parts.<ref name="SWG:IDN" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Aii`tkian Anthropologists appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Aii`tkian Anthropologists were added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:DS" />
